Coram : P. SATHASIVAM*, A.K. PATNAIK
CONSUMER PROTECTION ACT, 1986: Restitution - Complaint against the carrier company for A B c the goods damaged in transit - District forum holding the carrier company liable to the consignees for negligence - Held: If the amount determined by District Forum covered the price the carrier had returned the said 0 goods to the consigner and the latter having received the price of said consignment from the consignees, also retained the consignment or disposed it of but has not paid the realized amount to the carrier, the consigner would stand unjustly enriched - Matter
Decision Date : 07-12-2011 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 3546/2006 | Disposal Nature : Case Partly allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
